q1_repeat_categories.answer: Users repeatedly buy from the same categories due to convenience, despite experiencing some issues with product quality, pricing, and customer support.

q2_exploration_blockers.answer: High prices, poor product quality, and unhelpful customer support prevent users from exploring new categories.

q3_discovery_channels.answer: Users primarily discover products through search and word-of-mouth recommendations.

q4_habit_role.answer: Habits play a significant role in shopping behavior, with many users regularly purchasing from the same categories for convenience and daily essentials.

q5_info_needed.answer: Users need information about product quality, pricing, and customer support before trying a new category.

q6_recurring_frustrations.answer: Recurring frustrations include high prices, poor product quality, and unhelpful customer support.

q7_experimenting_segments.answer: The 'explorer' segment is more likely to experiment with new categories and products.

q8_unmet_needs.answer: Unmet needs include better product quality, more competitive pricing, and improved customer support.
